discrepancy.note: Troki himself flags the discrepancy: Luke's law-and-prophets-until-John points to a temporary law, against Matthew's Jesus vowing not to abolish it.

quotes.text: the law and the prophecies had only a certain temporary object in view, which was to find its point of completion in John, a contemporary of Jesus.
quotes.attr: Isaac ben Abraham Troki (d. 1594), Faith Strengthened (Chizzuk Emunah), Part II, ch. XV (1851 trans.), on Luke 16:16.

sides.snippet: Know therefore that Yahweh your God, he is God, the faithful God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness with them who love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations,
sides.verseText: Know therefore that Yahweh your God, he is God, the faithful God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness with them who love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations,

sides.snippet: The law and the prophets were until John. From that time the Gospel of the Kingdom of God is preached, and everyone is forcing his way into it.
sides.verseText: The law and the prophets were until John. From that time the Gospel of the Kingdom of God is preached, and everyone is forcing his way into it.
